Factor: Weaknesses

Factor: Dependence on a small core team
Description: Critical industry knowledge is concentrated in our domain expert, while product development depends heavily on one core technical founder. Any change in availability or capacity of these key people would directly slow down product evolution and implementation speed.

Description: Selling to municipalities and public utilities implies long sales cycles (often 6–18+ months) and navigating public procurement procedures and political decision making, which can significantly delay contracts even when the problem–solution fit is strong.

Factor: Limited local budgets and geographic concentration
Description: Initial revenues will depend on the budgets of a relatively small number of municipalities and public utilities in the Western Balkans. Economic downturns, elections, or shifting policy priorities in these markets can have a disproportionate impact on our sales pipeline.

Factor: Risk of technical debt from a fast MVP
Description: Due to the pressure to have an MVP ready by the end of 2026, there is a risk that certain aspects of the architecture (multitenancy, security, integrations) are implemented pragmatically for the first pilot rather than fully future‑proofed, leading to potentially expensive refactoring when scaling to many cities and cross‑border deployments.
